headline: Nippon India and HDFC lead multi-asset fund SIP returns
summary: Multi-asset allocation mutual funds have generated positive SIP returns over the last two years despite volatility in benchmark indices. Nippon India and HDFC funds are highlighted among the top performers in this category. Conversely, the report identifies three funds that have lagged behind in SIP performance during the same period. This data provides a comparative look at how different fund houses manage asset allocation strategies for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Helps assess if your multi-asset SIP is underperforming peers.
winners_losers: Top-tier funds gain / Laggard funds hurt
